en.title: Auxiliary and main verbs
en.summary: A main verb carries the meaning; an auxiliary verb helps it to form a tense, a question or a negative.

paragraphs: A main verb carries the meaning of the clause. An auxiliary verb helps the main verb to form a tense, a question or a negative. A verb phrase can have one main verb and one or more auxiliaries. The auxiliary comes first and the main verb follows.

The auxiliary verbs are be, have and do. The modal verbs, such as can, must and will, are auxiliaries too, but they add meaning of their own. Be, have and do can also be main verbs: She has a car. The auxiliary also carries the negative: not goes after it.

blocks.html:
AuxiliaryUseExample
becontinuous, passiveHe is working.
haveperfectShe has left.
doquestions, negativesDo you know? I don't know.
will, wouldfuture, conditionalThey will come.
can, must, maymodalityYou must stop.

sections.title: Be, have and do as main verbs

paragraphs: When be is the only verb, it does not need do for questions: Is she here? When have means own, British speakers often do the same: Have you a pen? Most speakers now use do: Do you have a pen?
We answer a yes-no question by repeating the auxiliary: Are you ready? Yes, I am. Have you eaten? No, I haven't. Do you smoke? No, I don't. The main verb is not repeated.

items: Wrong: **Do you can swim?** Right: **Can you swim?**
Wrong: **She is work.** Right: **She is working.**
Wrong: **I no know.** Right: **I don't know.**

ro.title: Verbe auxiliare și principale
ro.summary: Verbul principal exprimă acțiunea de bază, iar verbul auxiliar ajută la formarea timpurilor compuse în limba română.

paragraphs: Verbul principal poartă sensul cel mai important din propoziție. Verbul auxiliar este un simplu ajutor gramatical. El ajută verbul principal să formeze timpuri compuse, precum trecutul sau viitorul.

În română, verbele auxiliare principale sunt „a avea”, „a vrea” și „a fi”. De obicei, verbul auxiliar stă în fața verbului principal. Româna nu folosește auxiliare pentru negație sau pentru a pune întrebări.

blocks.html:
AuxiliarRol gramaticalExemplu
a aveaformează trecutul (perfectul compus)Eu am mâncat un măr.
a vreaformează timpul viitorVoi veți scrie o scrisoare.
a fiformează diateza pasivă și timpuri compuseScrisoarea a fost trimisă.
